verdict.rationale: Unity documents public scripting APIs (unity-docs-11) and editor extension APIs (unity-docs-10), and has a large community AI-tooling ecosystem (CoplayDev/unity-mcp, 14k stars), which hints at broad public familiarity. Nothing in the evidence directly shows that LLM-generated Unity code works on the first try, that the APIs are stable, or that public examples are abundant. The docs.unity3d.com manual also has no llms.txt or .md mirrors, though docs.unity.com does serve an llms.txt index. missing for 10: evidence of API stability across versions, evidence of abundant public code examples, hands-on reports of LLM-generated code accuracy, machine-readable scripting API docs.
